create_independent_distribution: create an Independent distribution by wrapping a base distribution with reinterpreted batch dimensions
sample_from_independent: sample from an Independent distribution using the sample method with a PRNG key
compute_log_prob_independent: compute the log probability of a value under an Independent distribution by summing over reinterpreted dimensions
calculate_entropy_independent: calculate the entropy of an Independent distribution by summing the child distribution entropy over reinterpreted batch dims
compute_kl_divergence_independent: compute the KL divergence between two Independent distributions with matching event shapes
